title: Transcript/cwd-keyed history lanes can't aggregate worktree sessions under their base project filter
wanted_capability: Filtering cwd-keyed history by a project should match work done in every checkout of that project, including out-of-tree worktrees. bbox_search / bbox_cite / bbox_sessions_list and work_tool_calls key records by the literal session/call cwd and filter by substring, so: in-tree worktree records (.claude/worktrees/...) accidentally match a base-path filter (path containment), but out-of-tree fleet/agent worktree sessions (under $BRO_HOME/fleet|agent/worktrees) are invisible under a base filter, and a worktree-path filter sees only that one checkout. Query-time rescoping is the WRONG fix here (unlike the store surfaces fixed in 372fac2..a9eaef1): the record key is the literal cwd, and per-candidate git probes at query time are too expensive. Wanted: index-time base-project resolution — stamp each transcript/tool-call doc with a resolved base-project key (via resolve_base_project_for_scope at ingest) alongside the raw cwd, let the project filter match either, and backfill on reindex.
missing_primitive: resolved base-project field on transcript/tool-call index docs (ingest-time worktree→base resolution + reindex backfill)
fallback_used: Query with substring fragments that match both path shapes (e.g. the repo directory name), or query per-worktree-path and merge manually.
evidence: crates/bbox-indexing/src/projects.rs:513 (resolve_base_project_for_scope — the ingest-time resolver to reuse)
design/corpus/agentic-corpus/project-taxonomy-standardization.md (taxonomy this fix must follow: project_id is the durable identity; resolution order; workspace maps for contained cwds)
notes: Intersects design/corpus/agentic-corpus/project-taxonomy-standardization.md (proposed): the fix MUST follow that taxonomy — stamp the durable project_id (not another path-shaped key) on transcript/tool-call docs at ingest, and resolve filter values per the doc's resolution order (project_id → alias → host path → workspace alias → cwd as legacy fallback), ideally via the shared resolver that design introduces (src/tools/scope.rs is the store-surface seed of it). Two inputs that design owns: (a) session workspace maps are the only way to key contained-execution cwds like /work/... — until they exist those records stay unkeyed, same bucket as deleted worktrees; (b) project aliases ("blackbox") should be accepted by the search filter once the resolver lands. Coordinate before implementing so the ingest keying and the ProjectContext resolver land compatibly.
resolution_note: Shipped as taxonomy slice 4 (taxonomy/resolver-consolidation) and validated against the live prod daemon. Index-time base-project resolution exactly as proposed: resolve_base_project_for_scope moved down to bbox-corpus-core so the ingest pass can call it; each session file resolves its cwd once (memoized per distinct cwd on ToolEdgeContext) and stamps base_project_id on every transcript/tool_call doc; INDEX_SCHEMA_VERSION bump (agentic-corpus-g8-base-project-id) made the rebuild the backfill (18,632 files / 1.26M docs re-stamped). Query side: bbox_search/bbox_cite project filter = OR(legacy substring lane, exact base_project_id term) with the filter value resolved via project_id/alias/path; work_tool_calls gains the same OR lane; bbox_sessions_list (metadata-backed) resolves candidate cwds through the same gate memoized per distinct cwd. Live proof: bbox_search(project="blackbox") returns brodex fleet sessions with cwd under $BRO_HOME/fleet/worktrees/... — the exact previously-invisible case; sessions_list(project="blackbox") matches 407 sessions; work_tool_calls rows carry base_project_id.
